about: Sunbleached (Style Lab style 6) on the tutorial island only: what Tools/Unreal/build_island_style.py sunbleached apply sets, over the lab's own numbers in Tools/Unreal/style_sunbleached.py. Run apply again after changing anything here; undo puts the island back. Colours are linear RGB unless written '#rrggbb' (sRGB, as the lab gives them).

lights.about: Properties a lighting state never writes, by target (sun, skyLight, atmosphere, fog: the island's Sun, SkyLight, SkyAtmosphere and HeightFog), as the Python property names. light_color is a light's colour filter (linear here, stored as sRGB): the sun stays at its Day temperature (5300 K) and is warmed toward the lab's white-gold #ffdfa6; the sky light goes lavender, so whatever the sun doesn't reach (cast shadows too) reads cool against the gold (the lab's ambient #7f8cf0). lower_hemisphere_color is the warm bounce off the sunlit ground (the lab's #c89a72). The sun's soft shadows (light_source_angle; CSM on Medium hardly shows it) and its light shafts (the lab's godrays: from the sun's core only, #fff0cc).

post.about: The SunbleachedPost volume (above IslandPost). volume: post process settings by Python name (lists are Vector4s or colours, by the setting), each turned on; the exposure bias comes from exposureBias (high-key: the lab's 1.05 with its brighter sun). The lab's grade: saturation 1.12, contrast 1.06, an indigo lift (#0e0b20) in the shadows; the shadows' gain carries the lavender into cast shadows, which the materials can't see. A low, wide, gentle bloom (the luminous air) with its widest kernels warmed (the lab's halation, #ffcf8a). AO numbers only matter on High and Epic (Medium has no SSAO). material: M_SunbleachedPost (the cream haze and the lavender vignette); false drops it. screen: changes over style_sunbleached.POST (haze, vignette).

sky.about: Changes over style_sunbleached.SKY (the lab's sky): colours as they should look on screen; opacity 1 paints the whole sky on the dome, 0 lays only the cirrus over the engine's atmosphere.

terrain.about: Changes to M_Terrain's Sunbleached values ({scalars: {...}, vectors: {...}}, over style_sunbleached.lab_ground()).

effects.about: Water, smoke and waterfalls: the lab lifts them a little (value 1.05).

roles.about: Changes to the lab's options for a role (wood, rock, stone, metal, bark, foliage, grass, fabric, paper, ground, other), keys as style_sunbleached.lab_surface() makes them: saturation, value, hue, tint ['#rrggbb', amount], shade, rim, rimPower, bounce, glow, glitter {density, size, strength, far, spread} or null, sheen.

materials.about: Changes for one shared material's styled instance, by the shared material's name: {"MI_HouseTrim": {"vectors": {"BleachAdjust": [0.95, 1.2, 1.0, 0]}}}.

state.about: Off: the lighting state Day stays the default, as Looter.World.Lighting.Levels requires of the island (its sun at 292 degrees, 38 up). On: the lab's own low sun (bearing 64, 19 degrees up: from the spawn's view it stands ahead and to the right, the halo in frame, long lavender shadows), written into the lights and Day alike; that test fails until it allows a styled island its own Day (a C++ change). With it on, set lights.sun.light_color nearer [1, 0.95, 0.8]: the low sun's light crosses more air and is already warmer.
